title: Electronic and Magnetic Properties Schema
description: A schema for extracting material composition, electronic structure, and magnetic property data.

electronic_magnetic_properties.description: A list of materials and their associated electronic and magnetic properties.

composition.description: The composition in the format Element:ratio,Element:ratio (e.g., Zr:1,O:2; Ti:0.5,Al:0.5,N:1). Do NOT leave this field empty.

space_group.description: Space group notation (e.g., P2_1/c, P4_2/nmc, Fm-3m, P6_3/mmc, R-3c)

number_of_atoms.description: Total number of atoms in the unit cell (e.g., 3, 5, 8, 12). Leave empty if not mentioned

K_points.description: K-point mesh or sampling scheme (e.g., 6 9 6 9 6; 4×4×4; Monkhorst-Pack 6×6×6). Leave empty if not mentioned

theoretical_calculation_method.description: The theoretical method used (e.g., DFT, DFT+U, DFT-D, hybrid DFT). Leave empty if not mentioned

electronic_DOS.description: Electronic density of states description or analysis (e.g., total DOS and PDOS analysis, band gap from DOS). Leave empty if not mentioned

charge_density_distribution.description: Charge density distribution description (e.g., charge density map, electron density distribution). Leave empty if not mentioned

charge_density_difference.description: Charge density difference analysis (e.g., Δρ plot, charge transfer visualization). Leave empty if not mentioned

bader_charge.description: Bader charge analysis values (e.g., Fe:+1.23,O:-0.61; Ti=+2.1, Al=+0.3, N=-1.2). Leave empty if not mentioned

total_magnetic_moment.description: Total magnetic moment per unit cell with units (e.g., 4.0 μB; 2.5 μB/cell; 0.0 μB for non-magnetic). Leave empty if not mentioned

atomic_magnetic_moment.description: Atomic magnetic moments with units (e.g., Fe:2.3 μB,O:0.1 μB; μ_Fe=2.5 μB). Leave empty if not mentioned

magnetic_transition_temperature.description: Magnetic transition temperature (Curie or Néel temperature) with units (e.g., T_C=850 K; T_N=120 K). Leave empty if not mentioned

Magnetocrystalline_Anisotropy_Energy.description: Magnetocrystalline anisotropy energy with units (e.g., 0.5 meV/atom; MAE=1.2 meV). Leave empty if not mentioned

Easy_magnetization_direction.description: Easy magnetization axis or direction (e.g., [001]; c-axis; basal plane; in-plane). Leave empty if not mentioned
